build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with parameterized bar and jar positions
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object in the PHYRE scene with configurable scale and position
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable angle, scale, and position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task goal to require two balls to be touching each other
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to the TWO_BALLS solution tier category
